have been with the surgery since birth and haven't had any issues.  I've always found the reception staff, nurses and doctors to be very kind/helpful.   Covid changed how practices operate and some may not agree with telephone appointments or being seen by a pharmacy advisor, but they have to work within budgets and make the best use of the resource they have.  The practice covers a large area, so you may feel you get a better service at another practice, but do they have the same amount of patients. If you're not happy with the service, speak to them and if not resolved speak to the Health Board. I do think they are in a no win situation.  There are negative comments if you feel you are being rushed when seeing the doctor, when they do spend time with a patient, patients waiting complain they have been waiting too long.
